items.mainDefect: Dismissing the dialog through the overlay or Esc after enabling 2FA does not call onEnable(), leaving the settings UI stale.

secondary.defect: Dismissing the dialog does not reset its step, so reopening displays old backup codes without repeating the password flow.

items.mainDefect: Non-atomic backup code consumption allows concurrent logins to succeed using the same single-use code.

secondary.defect: Concurrent backup code writes can overwrite each other's updates, losing a consumption update.
